ai.suggestedSummary: DPA completed. The company called and reached the customer, and arrears were discussed. A clutch repair costing £780 used most of the customer’s available funds, while their working hours and wages remained unchanged; the customer declined an I&E assessment. The agent attempted to secure a card payment during the call, but the customer declined; the customer agreed to pay £100 through the online portal on 23 October. Next steps are for the company to call on 26 October after 4 pm to review the remaining arrears, once Friday’s payment has been received.
